```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(knitr)

opts_chunk$set(out.width = "80%", fig.align = "center")
```
<br>

This document provides quick access to the outputs generated by the replication scripts for the article. Model objects are saved as `RDS` files in `outputs/rds/`, figures are saved as `.png` files in `outputs/figures/` (e.g., `outputs/figures/f2.png`), and tables are generated in `analysis/03_figures_tables.R` and rendered directly here. Rendering this document is therefore intended to be the final step of the replication workflow. Tables and figures follow the same numbering and titles as in the manuscript, except where results are reported only in the text.  

<br>

#### Table 1: IOAE macroeconomic and financial time series
```{r}
readRDS(here::here("outputs/rds/prepared_tables/t1.rds"))
```
<br>
